question_cn: 两王直接面对面、中间隔一格，称为"对立"。谁先走谁就失去对立。白方要推兵升变，应该：
question_en: Opposition means kings face each other with one square between them, and the side to move loses it. To promote the pawn, White should:

options.text_cn: 先用王占据对立位，再推兵
options.text_en: First gain the opposition with the king, then advance the pawn
Just push the pawn and ignore opposition
Bring the queen to help promote
Get the pawn to the promotion square first

explanation_cn: 先手对王是兵残局的核心元思维：王占对立 → 黑王被迫让路 → 白兵顺利推进。没有王的配合，多数情况下白方无法赢棋。
explanation_en: Gaining opposition is the core meta-concept in pawn endgames: king takes opposition → Black king forced to yield → pawn advances freely.
